nodes.description: Pool.deposit(uint256 value): pulls UNI-V2 from msg.sender and stages it
Pool.withdraw(uint256 value): sends staged UNI-V2 back to msg.sender
Pool.claim(uint256 value): sends claimable ETHC to msg.sender
Pool.bond(uint256 value): moves staged balance into bonded state and mints phantom accounting
Pool.unbond(uint256 value): moves bonded balance back to staged/claimable
Pool.provide(uint256 value): adds liquidity to the Uniswap pair and bonds the LP tokens
Pool.emergencyWithdraw(address token, uint256 value): DAO-only sweep of arbitrary tokens
Oracle.capture(): DAO-only price capture using Uniswap cumulative prices and block.timestamp
Oracle.setup(): DAO-only creation/binding of the ETHC-DAI Uniswap pair
Permittable.permit(): EIP-712 signature based approval with nonce and deadline
Upgradeable.upgradeTo(address newImplementation): writes the EIP-1967 slot and delegatecalls initialize()
Liquidity.addLiquidity(uint256 ethicAmount): transfers ETHC/DAI into the pair and mints LP tokens
Ethic.transferFrom: transfers tokens and skips allowance decrement when allowance is uint256(-1)
Deployer.implement(address implementation): unpermissioned external entry that upgrades the proxy
Deployer1.initialize(): deploys the Ethic token and stores it in proxy state
Deployer2.initialize(): deploys the Oracle and calls setup()
Deployer3.initialize(): deploys the Pool contract from the proxy
msg.sender: externally controlled caller of entry points
block.timestamp: miner-influenced time source used by the oracle and permit
univ2().transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), value) inside Pool.deposit
univ2().transfer(msg.sender, value) inside Pool.withdraw
ethic().transfer(msg.sender, value) inside Pool.claim
ecrecover(digest, v, r, s) on caller supplied signature inside Permittable.permit
newImplementation.delegatecall(abi.encodeWithSignature("initialize()")) inside Upgradeable.upgradeTo
IUniswapV2Factory(UNISWAP_FACTORY).createPair(_ethic, dai()) inside Oracle.setup
IERC20(token).transfer(address(dao()), value) inside Pool.emergencyWithdraw
IERC20(ethic).transfer / IERC20(dai).transferFrom / pair.mint calls inside addLiquidity

Oracle._timestamp, _cumulative, _reserve, _index and _initialized price accumulator state

edges.reason: msg.sender invokes deposit and its UNI-V2 tokens are pulled into the pool
deposit performs the external transferFrom before the staged balance is credited
deposit value parameter is passed as the external transferFrom amount
external call happens before the account staged balance is written in PoolStorage state
msg.sender withdraws its staged UNI-V2 balance
withdraw transfers UNI-V2 out before decrementing the staged balance (state update after external call)
state mutation occurs after the external token transfer, leaving a re-entrancy window
withdraw value parameter is the amount forwarded in the external transfer
msg.sender claims its reward balance
claim transfers ETHC to msg.sender before decrementing the claimable balance
claimable balance is decremented after the external ETHC transfer
claim value parameter is the ETHC amount transferred
msg.sender bonds its staged balance
bond rewrites bonded and phantom balances with multiplication/division arithmetic over pool state
bond value parameter drives the staged to bonded conversion
newPhantom is computed with mul then div by totalBonded and stored in pool state
msg.sender unbonds bonded balance
newClaimable = balanceOfRewarded * value / balanceOfBonded can round or revert on division
unbond value parameter scales the claimable and phantom reductions
msg.sender provides rewarded ETHC as liquidity
provide delegates the asset movement to addLiquidity
addLiquidity performs ETHC transfer, DAI transferFrom from msg.sender and pair.mint external calls
provide value parameter is the ETHC amount added to the pair
emergencyWithdraw checks msg.sender == address(dao()) before sweeping funds
emergencyWithdraw executes an arbitrary token transfer to the DAO
token address parameter selects the IERC20 contract that is transferred from
capture is behind the onlyDao modifier checking msg.sender against stored DAO address
oracle price capture derives elapsed time from block.timestamp (timestamp dependency)
timeElapsed = blockTimestamp - _timestamp uses raw uint32 arithmetic with division by elapsed time
timeElapsed scales the cumulative price and updates _timestamp and _cumulative
setup is onlyDao and binds the pair used for pricing
setup calls the UniswapV2 factory createPair external call
permit is unpermissioned; anyone may submit owner/spender/value/signature data
permit recovers the signer with ecrecover from caller supplied v, r, s
owner parameter is hashed into the digest that ecrecover validates
spender parameter is hashed into the digest that ecrecover validates
deadline parameter is compared against block.timestamp for signature expiry
permit uses now (block.timestamp) in the deadline check (timestamp dependency)
permit reads EIP712_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR to build the signed digest
permit reads and increments nonces[owner] to prevent replay
address returned by ecrecover is the value compared against owner
Deployer.implement is external with no access control, any caller can trigger an upgrade
unpermissioned implement forwards caller supplied address into upgradeTo
upgradeTo delegatecalls an attacker supplied implementation, allowing arbitrary proxy state writes
newImplementation parameter is fully attacker controlled
implementation slot is overwritten, allowing proxy takeover
Deployer1.initialize writes the deployed Ethic token into proxy provider state
Deployer2.initialize writes the deployed Oracle into proxy provider state
Deployer3.initialize writes the deployed Pool address into proxy provider state
initialize is publicly callable and only guarded by the initializer modifier

any holder may call Ethic.transferFrom with arbitrary sender/recipient
Ethic.transferFrom mutates the ERC20 _balances mapping (infinite allowance skips decrement)
